about.ack-failed: The acknowledgements list isn't available right now
about.ack-none: No contributors have been added to the list yet
about.ack-source-value: The list and its built-in avatars come from a static address this project manages; for contributors registered with a Minecraft player name, the skin is looked up through Mojang's public profile API and the texture is fetched from its CDN. These requests carry no account, credential or local file information; the list snapshot and the skin copies are kept in this machine's config directory so the page still renders offline
about.credentials-value: Credential data stays in this machine's config; it never enters logs, task saves or exported packs
about.data-source-value: Modrinth API and CurseForge API, plus the mirror chosen in Settings
about.disclaimer: SideShift is an independent third-party tool with no affiliation with, or endorsement by, Mojang Studios or Microsoft. Minecraft and its related names and assets are trademarks or copyrighted works of their respective owners. This project is released under the Apache License 2.0, ships no official content, and converts the packs you already own.
about.network-scope-value: Outgoing requests happen in three cases only: mod and version metadata lookup, update checks, and fetching the acknowledgements list
about.positioning: Independent third-party tool · Apache-2.0 licensed · No telemetry
about.process-value: Unpacking, side detection and rebuilding all run on this machine; pack contents are never uploaded
about.telemetry-value: No telemetry or analytics are integrated, and no usage data is written to disk
about.tp-loaders: Mod loader ecosystems whose public specs the conversion plan is judged against
about.tp-meta: Sources of mod and version metadata
about.tp-modnames: Offline dictionary of Chinese mod names
about.tp-self: The license this project itself is published under
